title.narrative: Transparency Now: Region-Wide Support to the EU Southern Neighbourhood to Improve Anti-Corruption Policy and Operational Outcomes (UNICRI)

description.narrative: Transparency International is a co-implementing partner of this Action contracted by United Nations Interregional Crime and Justice Research Institute (UNICRI). The project supports our work in the MENA region and aims to facilitate improved prevention, reporting and repression of acts of corruption, as well as the seizure and confiscation of assets linked to such corruption, throughout the EU Southern Neighbourhood. Countries involved are Palestine, Jordan, Lebanon, Tunisia, and Morocco. Value of contract: 2,500,000 Euros.

participating-org.narrative: European Commission - Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations

recipient-country.narrative: This project is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany. The countries involved are Palestine, Jordan, Lebanon, Tunisia, and Morocco.
